name: East Branch Pecatonica River
gaugeName: EAST BRANCH PECATONICA RIVER NR BLANCHARDVILLE, WI
blurb: East Branch Pecatonica River in Wisconsin between Wisconsin DNR-listed public accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.putIn: Robert E. Wenger Memorial Boat Landing
sections.notes: Markers identify agency-listed access; the map states whether a landing or an approximate facility area has been reviewed. Mileage is preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry; it is not a surveyed paddling route. Difficulty has not been independently rated for every section. Check current conditions, hazards and access with the managing agency before paddling.
sections.accessReview: Wenger landing is upstream of the Argyle dam site. DNR still lists Argyle Dam as present, while the village describes old dam remnants and separate landings above and below it. A currently usable passage or authorized carry has not been established. Do not plan this as a continuous float.
sections.routeReview: The existing Wenger access area is upstream of the highway bridge and dam site. The village’s separate below-dam landing is not the same put-in. Confirm a usable, authorized carry or choose a separately reviewed downstream trip; do not paddle toward the dam expecting an open route.

notices.title: Argyle landing and dam
notices.text: The village lists Wenger landing off Highway 81 and Lancaster landing off Mill Street. It describes landings above and below the dam, but this does not establish a usable carry between them. The current Wenger marker has not been moved to the downstream landing.
notices.sourceName: Village of Argyle — parks and recreation
